subject.title: feat(agents): screen tool drives Control UI layout (ui.command channel)

question: Should `ui.command` control every connected capable Control UI, or only the originating/session-viewing UI client?
rationale: The umbrella issue describes session-scoped delivery, while this PR deliberately implements global fanout; both are technically possible but have materially different multi-client UX and authority boundaries.

options.title: Target the relevant UI
options.body: Route commands only to the originating or session-viewing capable client so unrelated operator screens remain unchanged.

options.title: Keep global fanout
options.body: Accept synchronized control of every capable Control UI as intentional behavior and document that consequence before merge.

recommendation.title: Target the relevant UI
recommendation.body: Route commands only to the originating or session-viewing capable client so unrelated operator screens remain unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked presentation-tier direction and have the strongest relevant Control UI history.
